feeds.title: Cruise Line Blog
feeds.description: Cruise Line is the UK's original luxury cruise specialist and a leading agent for many of the world's finest cruise lines including Silversea, Oceania Cruises, Regent Seven Seas and Cunard. Find the latest cruise news, articles and reviews, cruise deals and offers, exceptional service and general cruise holiday information.

feeds.title: Cruise Miss
feeds.description: A cruise blog with a difference by Danielle. Follow this blog as I take you on a journey through the world of cruise travel.

feeds.title: No Fly Cruises
feeds.description: Number 1 Free Guide to No Fly Cruises that depart directly from UK ports. Expert & detailed port guides, maps, news, cruise deals, and reviews all about cruises from UK ports.

feeds.title: Shipmonk
feeds.description: Dave Monk has been a journalist for 44 years, most recently as deputy editor of Metro, Britain's best-read daily paper. He began writing about cruising in 2005 and was voted best blogger in the Cruise International Awards 2016 - the year he gave up work to write about cruising full time.

feeds.title: Cruise Mummy
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jenni Fielding. My goal is to help as many people as possible to make the most of their cruises, whether that's finding the right ship, choosing the best cabin, deciding whether to buy a drink package, or anything else.

feeds.title: World of Cruising
feeds.description: World of Cruising is a luxury publication packed with the latest cruise trends and our destination guides to inspire you for your next cruise. Find out the latest cruise news and what it means for your cruising plans and holidays abroad. We've got everything you need to know about traffic light system changes, Government guidance, cancelled cruises as well as cruise line updates, from P&O cruise news to Princess Cruises news.

feeds.title: Cruise Lowdown Blog
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome to a cruise website with a difference designed specifically with contemporary travelers in mind, whatever their age. Find cruise news, reviews, photos, new ships, tours, deck plans, cabins, dining, bars, entertainment, destinations, & more.

feeds.title: Emmaonline Blog
feeds.description: View my latest blog posts for the cruise tips, event information and destination guides. Here on my little corner of the internet, I share cruise tips, destination guides and event information to show how I see the best of places, despite having limited time, so you can too.

feeds.title: Cruise with Amber Blog
feeds.description: First things first: I've been obsessed by cruise holidays since 2005 when I first stepped aboard P&O's Oceana. I haven't looked back. My favourite sign in the whole world is 'To the ship' closely followed by 'Gin Parlour' and 'Tea Rooms'). When I'm not planning a cruise, thinking about a cruise or on a cruise I'm usually running my own business which has absolutely nothing to do with cruises, but helps pay for cruises.

feeds.title: Cruising For All
feeds.description: Cruising With Kids is designed for parents of children of all ages looking for cruise reviews, news, tips and tricks, port information and more! elcome to Cruising With Kids Family Cruise Blog, here we will offer tips and advice to help you choose the best cruise for your family.

feeds.title: About Luxury Cruising Blog
feeds.description: About Luxury Cruising is a Cruise blog designed to inspire and encourage you travel and cruise more often. Tried and tested real life advice.

feeds.title: Cruise Blondes
feeds.description: Cruise Blondes is packed with inspirational but refreshingly honest reviews, cruise news, celebrity interviews, dreamy destinations and the hottest ships to help cruisers plan their perfect holiday. Cruise Blondes is a new premium digital magazine celebrating all things cruise created by two award-winning travel editors, Rebecca Barnes and Karen Pasquali Jones.

feeds.title: Reasons To Cruise Blog
feeds.description: Reasons To Cruise Is David Fiske's Cruise And Travel Blog. Here You'll Find Cruise Tips And Advice Helping You Plan An Exciting Mini Taster Cruise Holiday From The UK.

feeds.title: Beyond Cruise
feeds.description: BeyondCruise is your one-stop website for you to find out information on cruise ships, cruise lines, and destination ports from all around the world. BeyondCruise is your ultimate guide to cruise lines, cruise ships, ports and destinations from around the world! View our latest news, guides, photos!

feeds.title: The Cruise Blogger
feeds.description: Unpacking the myths about cruise holidays. Follow this blog as I talk about popular cruise ports, offer tried and tested advice and share photos from cruise ships across the industry.

feeds.title: Paramount Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles from destination inspiration to all the latest cruise news. Paramount is a boutique, independent cruise specialist travel agency focused on great value, tailor-made cruise packages which will leave you with lasting memories.

feeds.title: Iglu Cruise Blog
feeds.description: The UKs largest cruise travel agency keeping you up to date with the latest news, unbeatable offers & travel chat.

feeds.title: TUI UK » Cruise Travel
feeds.description: This section features the latest cruise travel articles including cruise travel tips, cruise destinations, info on Marella cruises, and general travel advice. TUI is the largest leisure, travel, and tourism company in the world, and it owns travel agencies, hotels, airlines, cruise ships, and retail shops.
